description: Drafting teaches technical drawing by hand and on computer: preparing drawing sheets, scale drawings with a bill of materials, a CAD drawing, comparing manual and computer drafting, lettering, visiting a workplace, and how drafting tools have changed.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Excerpts were partly out of order; requirements 5–7 are outlined from topic and should be confirmed against the official list.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
